name: fastfetch
description: Fast, actively-maintained neofetch-like system information tool

xdg.instructions: fastfetch's Windows config search list is hardcoded (Win32 known-folder lookups) and ignores XDG_CONFIG_HOME entirely -- confirmed via `fastfetch --list-config-paths` with XDG_CONFIG_HOME set to a probe path. Tools/fastfetch.ps1 wraps the executable and passes --config explicitly, and its one-time setup seeds the themed default config (Tools/fastfetch/config.jsonc).
